_source: ColdFusion long video, watched in the built-in browser 2026-11-18: frame mosaics (0-15 s dense, 18-90 s every 3-6 s, then 180/300/450/640/900/1250/1570 s), 0.2 s burst at 2-3 s and 0.5 s burst at 72-75 s, word timings from YouTube's transcript panel (about 200 words a minute), sound probe 73-163 s. Our own descriptions; shots after 95 s are spot samples, not a full list. 2.7M views in 3 days.

hook.firstFrame: a dark stock chart, thin orange price line with the company logo top-left, faint grid
hook.firstLine: Opens on the size of the company's market-value loss in four trading days.

shots.picture: dark stock chart, orange line drawing on left to right, logo and price top-left
the line dives at its end, orange '-$500 Billion' label beside the drop, a dated dot lands
press photo of the CEO on stage in a leather jacket, slow push
a news headline page announcing the CEO's exit, dimmed photo behind
news photo of the CEO with a head of state
black frame: orange pie chart of chip market share, client logos stack in below it one per name, CEO footage cut out on the right
drone-style footage of the company headquarters atrium
big orange '5-6%' with a small grey line under it on a dark blurred background
a financial news article scrolling, headline about AI spending driving growth
TV morning-show clip with a lower-third about the CEO
the company's logo sign on a stone wall, slow drift
archive photos of the young founder in the 1990s office
street footage of the CEO gesturing to reporters
light graph-paper board: photo cards slide in one by one with long soft shadows, then a dark '?' card for the unknown person
cable-news investigation clips about chips reaching China, then a talking-head interview
agency seals over a dark photo, news clips, interview clips (spot-sampled)
a report page in grey text with one sentence lit black and the rest dimmed
a public statement as grey text on near-black, the current sentence lit white
server-rack footage with a huge white '1000x' over it
3D render of an AI accelerator board, top-down, dark
a white stock-chart screenshot of the share price falling
interview clips of an investor on a dark stage, news footage
moody dark office at night, a man at a desk, city lights outside (outro)

lines.gist: the staggering value the company lost in days as its famous CEO leaves
this personal scandal matters more than gossip, and here is why
the company makes nearly all advanced AI chips and powers every big AI lab
it is a big slice of the stock index and of national growth
if you own a pension or index fund, you own a piece of it
the founder ran it for three decades with a flat structure and no deputy
three affairs, one with a suspected foreign intelligence asset
frontier chips are strategic weapons, so this is a security problem; a pundit agrees

ending.cta: subscribe / see other episodes (spoken), closing proverb
ending.lastFrame: dark office at night, a lone figure at a desk

whyItWorks: The biggest number lands in the first second as a chart line diving, with one orange label; the story question comes after.
Stakes are widened in steps (company, market, economy, your pension) before the backstory starts at 52 s.
Documents are shown as dimmed text with only the spoken sentence lit, so reading and listening line up.
Every 4-5 s a new picture, mostly real footage and photos; the few made graphics are orange-on-black and minimal.
